claims.statement: UltraFire BRC 18650 records are contradictory: historical entries include protected button-top 4000mAh-labeled/fake variants, while other BRC listings are unprotected flat-top. The catalog revision's terminal style and protection status therefore remain unresolved.
Steam Engine preserves UltraFire BRC 18650 4000mAh li-ion 2600mAh 1.15C as a 2600mAh preset with a 1.15C runtime rating.
UltraFire BRC 18650 is marketed as a rechargeable lithium-ion cell, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry UltraFire BRC 18650 4000mAh li-ion has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2012-03-29 or earlier.
